data.description:
As a maintainer, I want merge-to-main to self-heal (or cleanly prevent) the diverged/spent source-branch case so a promotion on a reused/rewritten branch does not dead-end at a manual `git push --force-with-lease` + `DSO_ALLOW_PUSH_TO_MERGED_PR=1` dance — WITHOUT ever weakening the "every commit reaching main is reviewed" guarantee.

## Provenance
Design converged via the epic-588e 3-lens panel (ground-truth / historical / maintainability) + convergence reviewer (APPROVED, no new criticals). Full converged proposal: the rev.2 design summarized below. SC6-aligned toil-reduction (per 830c N1/N2). Surfaced while landing the 588e enforce-flip: the same worktree branch was reused + rewritten across 3 promotions, and each promotion dead-ended on a non-fast-forward push.

## Problem
merge-to-main-pr.sh version-bumps the source branch, pushes it, then opens PR1. When local history has diverged from origin/<branch> (branch reused after its prior PR merged = "spent"; or history rewritten), the push fails non-ff and the script emits CONFLICT_DATA{resolution_strategy:pr-create-failed} and STOPS. Operator must force-push manually. The CONFLICT_DATA also mis-routes a push-divergence to /dso:resolve-conflicts (consumers key on the prefix).

## Shared primitive
`_branch_is_spent(<branch>)` — SPENT iff BOTH: (1) patch-equivalence: `git rev-list --count --right-only --cherry-pick origin/main...origin/<branch>` == 0 (correctly covers REBASE/SQUASH merges where original SHAs are NOT ancestors of main — the naive `merge-base --is-ancestor` test is dead-on-arrival on this rebase-merge repo); AND (2) forge-proof: `gh pr list --head <branch> --state merged` returns a merged PR1. Fail-CLOSED to NOT-SPENT on OPEN / CLOSED-unmerged / unreadable/partial PR state (INC-008: a partial forge read is INDETERMINATE, never authoritative-empty). Fail-closed-to-NOT-SPENT is conservative at every call site below.

## Done Definition

### v1 (advisory — no destructive auto-execution; ships independently)
- DD0 (prevention, headline): at promotion START, if `_branch_is_spent`, REFUSE to reuse the source branch with a clear "spent (PR1 merged); start from a fresh branch off origin/main" error (or auto-cut a fresh branch behind an opt-in). NOTE: the refusal still applies when an operator adds NEW commits to a spent branch — redirect to a fresh branch (any same-branch re-push trips the merged-PR hook regardless). Smallest blast radius; makes heal a rare fallback.
- DD1 (divergence classifier, new pre-push phase): `git fetch origin <branch>`, classify the FULL state set, deferring to existing helpers (no double-handling): origin absent (first push)->happy; local FF of origin->normal push; behind->_fetch_and_rebase_branch/_sync_branch_against_default; unrelated histories->existing guard (fail); diverged+`_branch_is_spent`->emit signal+STOP (v1); diverged+NOT-spent->GENUINE concurrent->FAIL-CLOSED, stay manual. Classifier ROUTES only; staged-ref deletion stays behind the forge-proof `_restage_staged_ref_safe_to_delete`.
- DD2 (tighten prebump-sync skip): narrow `_phase_prebump_feature_sync` (440-512) skip from "origin/<branch> exists" to "`_branch_is_spent`==FALSE" (skip only on genuine in-flight review), fail-CLOSED on CLOSED-unmerged/unreadable. Audit + mirror the SAME predicate at sibling force-push sites `_phase_source_branch_version_bump` (~719) and `_publish_rebased_branch` (~1433) — the e1bf "fixed one site not the sibling" lesson.
- DD3 (actionable signal): emit a DISTINCT top-level `SOURCE_BRANCH_DIVERGED:` line (NOT under the CONFLICT_DATA prefix, which routes to /dso:resolve-conflicts) carrying {classification: spent|concurrent, recommended_command, rollback}. Update end-session / debug-everything consumer prompts to recognize it; refresh the stale resolve-conflicts/SKILL.md value vocabulary (pr-auto-merge/gh-pr-create -> live pr-create-failed/pr-conflict) in the same change.
- DD4 (resume parity): route `--resume` through the classifier so it does not re-attempt a doomed push after the idempotent-skipped bump.
- DD5 (`_restage_execute` rollback — even for the manual path): record original branch+HEAD; on EVERY error return `git checkout` back + delete the just-minted local fresh branch; guard the empty-fresh-branch case (spent + zero unmatched commits -> explicit no-op, not an empty PR). Restores `patch-before-destructive`; failures no-worse than today's clean fail-stop.

### v2 (follow-up — HARD depends_on 3274)
- DD6 (auto-invoke re-stage on spent-branch push failure): flip DD1's SPENT branch from "signal+STOP" to auto-invoking `_restage_execute`, behind `DSO_RESTAGE_EXECUTE` AND only after 3274 lands (m1 integration tests, m2 fresh-name collision retry, m3 lock-staleness/PID recovery). Matches the advisory->enforce pattern. Re-justify fresh-branch push safety against the push-event RULESET axis (the GH013/e1bf cause — review-sub-pr fires on PR events only, so a push is expected-safe; confirm against live branch rulesets), not just the merged-PR hook.

## Non-negotiable invariants
- NEVER land un-reviewed commits on main: heal pushes a FRESH branch and REQUIRES a fresh merge-to-main run (PR1 review-sub-pr + PR2 review-gate re-run); never auto-merges; never credits prior review onto rewritten SHAs. Add an invariant TEST: the fresh-branch heal path can never chain into an auto-merge within the same invocation.
- NEVER auto-force-push a branch with genuine concurrent commits.
- NEVER blanket `-X ours` a rebase.
- `_branch_is_spent` fails CLOSED on any forge-read indeterminacy.
- review-gate / required_linear_history unaffected (branch-plumbing only; flow already rebases onto pinned/origin main = linear direction). Re-check any change to which SHA PR2 lands at against `rc_a3b_should_exclude` (bug 374f area).

## Course-correction trigger
If implementation cannot make `_branch_is_spent` reliably distinguish spent from concurrent (forge-read flakiness), ship DD0 (prevention) + DD3 (signal) only and defer the classifier-driven heal.
data.title: Self-heal merge-to-main on diverged/spent source branch: divergence classifier + reuse-prevention + actionable signal (v1 advisory); gated auto-restage (v2)
